entities.name: The Invention of Modern Christmas
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Dickens' "A Christmas Carol" (1843), Prince Albert's Christmas tree (1848), and Coca-Cola's Santa Claus (1931) invented Christmas as we know it. Before the Victorians, Christmas was a rowdy street festival, not a family gathering. The Puritans had actually banned it (1647-1660).
